# Acceptable Use Policy

Neon is part of the Databricks Platform. Please refer to the [Databricks Acceptable Use Policy](https://www.databricks.com/legal/acceptable-use-policy).

For Neon-specific expectations on abuse of resources, unauthorized modifications, and other security and compliance topics, see [Security overview](https://neon.com/docs/security/security-overview).
